## Description

Brief summary of changes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Token / styling change
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (no functional changes)

## Atomic Level Affected

- [ ] Atoms
- [ ] Molecules
- [ ] Organisms
- [ ] Templates
- [ ] Tokens (`src/index.css` — CSS custom properties + `@theme` block)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] CI / Tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows design token rules — no hardcoded colors (`text-white`, `bg-black`, etc.)
- [ ] Uses correct font families — `font-display` for headings/buttons, `font-body` for text, `font-mono` for data/code
- [ ] Tested in all three themes (Dark, Light, Warm)
- [ ] Verified WCAG AA contrast ratios
- [ ] Components use semantic Tailwind classes (`bg-surface`, `text-muted-foreground`, etc.)
- [ ] Props use explicit TypeScript interfaces
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/`)
- [ ] `design-tokens.json` updated if CSS variables changed
